refuter.evidence:
The reader never wrote a file with the ADVANCING phrase, which 1985 allows on every sequential file and implies on every WRITE (§1985:VII.4.7.4 GR16). src/r3ord.cob at --std 85: FA (no ORGANIZATION clause, PIC X(3)) written with WRITE A01 AFTER ADVANCING 2 LINES, WRITE A02 BEFORE ADVANCING PAGE, WRITE A03; CLOSE; OPEN INPUT FA; four READs printed 'FA [<LF><LF>A] 00', 'FA [01<CR>] 00', 'FA [A02] 00', 'FA [<FF><LF>A] 00' (od of r3ord-001/r3a.dat: 
 
 A 0 1  A 0 2   
 A 0 3 
). Three records were placed; four records, none but one equal to a record placed, were retrieved with status 00 and no at end. Same program at --std 2023: identical output. The ordering the reader probed (OUTPUT/EXTEND/REWRITE/RECORD VARYING, plain WRITEs only) holds, as do my own probes in r3ord: OPEN OUTPUT of an existing file restarts the sequence (FT N01 then END 10) and OPEN EXTEND on an absent OPTIONAL file creates it (05) and appends E01 E02 then E03 across two EXTEND opens. Cause: DOC-A.1-146 (c') makes a record sequential file written with any ADVANCING phrase a 'print stream' whose medium carries line-control bytes between the fixed records (SequentialConnector.IsRecordPrintStream, SelectLineEnd, AdvancingDeclared), and ReadRecord reads that stream back as fixed 3-byte blocks; kb/Work PB1190 states 'a print file is written, not re-read as framed records', a determination argued from §2023 text, not 1985's. At 1985 the implementor may refuse reading such a file (I-O status 37, 'the INPUT phrase is specified but the file will not support read operations') but may not return records never placed with 00. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.6.3 GR2 the text is in GR2; OK §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR12 the text is in GR12 ('The successor relationship of a sequential file is established by the order of execution of WRITE statements'); OK §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR16 the text is in GR16; OK §1985:VII.1.3.5 it lies in GRL2.3d.3 ('The INPUT phrase is specified but the file will not support read operations'). kb/Work: no note found for re-reading a print stream (searched print+advancing+read back/re-read/OPEN INPUT; PB1190, PB2509, PB1664 concern the write form only). Doubt worth stating: if one reads the print stream as a different physical file whose records the implementor need not map back, the verdict would be DOUBTFUL; but the OPEN INPUT and READs report 00, so the program is told the records are its own.
